project_settings.title: Project settings
project_settings.generalDescription: Name, folder, GitHub account, what agents read from the repository, and auto mode.
project_settings.limitsDescription: Defaults and limits for {{project}}. They apply to new tasks and runs in this project.
project_settings.environmentDescription: Variables {{project}} adds for its agents and command tools.
project_settings.sourcesDescription: Folders and files outside the worktree that {{project}}'s agents may read without asking.
project_settings.codeIndexDescription: How agents find their way around {{project}}'s code.
project_settings.sharingDescription: Where {{project}}'s task list lives, and who works on it with you.

sourcesTab.title: Sources
sourcesTab.detail: Agents of every {{project}} run read and search inside these without asking you. Anything else outside the run's worktree asks you first. Tasks and pipeline steps can add their own sources; a run keeps the sources it started with.
sourcesTab.emptyText: Agents read only the run's worktree, and ask you before reading anywhere else. Add a folder or file they may read without asking, such as shared docs or a dependency's sources.
sourcesTab.question: Let agents read this without asking?
sourcesTab.outsideTitle: What agents may do outside the worktree
sourcesTab.readSource: Read and search in a source
sourcesTab.readElsewhere: Read anywhere else outside the worktree
sourcesTab.readElsewhereRule: Asks you: approve once, or approve similar for that folder in this run
sourcesTab.readElsewhereHow: Orchester · the request waits in Needs you
sourcesTab.changeHow: Orchester · editing and creating files work in the worktree only
sourcesTab.refusedRule: Any .git folder, Orchester's own data, credential files (.ssh, .aws, .env and the like), other projects' private state
sourcesTab.refusedHow: Orchester · refused before any approval; sources never hold secrets
sourcesTab.commandsRule: Not covered by sources: commands follow the profile's Commands permission
sourcesTab.laterTitle: Changes apply to runs that start later
sourcesTab.laterDetail: A running run keeps the sources it started with, including one you remove here, until it ends.

project_settings.outOfScope: This section is not built in this app yet.
project_settings.failed: Not saved · Orchester couldn't write the settings
project_settings.invalid: Not saved · fix the marked field
project_settings.finishEditing: Save or fix the changes in this section before opening another.
project_settings.reviewerUnavailable: Auto mode needs an agent connection in this project to review with: Claude Code, Codex or the Anthropic API.
project_settings.outsideDetail: Your edits are kept. Reload to show the values stored now.
project_settings.name: Project name
project_settings.nameDetail: Shown in the sidebar and breadcrumbs. Renaming is not available yet.
project_settings.keyDetail: The prefix of this project's task keys. Changing it is not available yet.
project_settings.folderDetail: Agents work in git worktrees of this folder, so it must be a git repository.
project_settings.folderNote: Git repository · moving the project is not available yet
project_settings.githubRepoDetail: Detected from the folder's origin remote. Pushes and pull requests go to this repository.
project_settings.repositoryNotLinked: No repository linked · check the folder's origin remote
project_settings.repositoryDetected: Repository found · linking it is not built in this app yet
project_settings.noGithubRemote: No GitHub remote · set origin to a GitHub repository, then check again
project_settings.gitRepositoryMissing: The folder is no longer a git repository
project_settings.gitCheckFailed: The repository couldn't be checked · check git and gh, then try again
project_settings.repositoryNoAccess: The signed-in GitHub account can't read this repository
project_settings.githubUnreachable: GitHub couldn't be reached · try again
project_settings.githubRateLimited: GitHub's rate limit was reached · try again later
project_settings.noDefaultBranch: The repository has no default branch yet
project_settings.githubSignedIn: Signed in as {{account}} · matches the expected account
project_settings.githubAccountDetail: Pull requests are created only while gh is signed in as this account. Orchester never switches gh accounts.
project_settings.githubUnavailable: Linking a repository is not built in this app yet. Manage GitHub in Connections.
project_settings.agentFilesDetail: Whether agents may read the repository's own AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and skills folders besides Orchester's instructions and skills. A change applies to agents that start after it.
project_settings.filesOff: Off · Orchester's instructions and skills only
project_settings.filesPanel: What each CLI may load from the repository
project_settings.filesNote: Agents read these files as they are in the run's worktree, so they are not versioned with the run. Claude Code is started without project settings, so it loads neither CLAUDE.md nor .claude/skills. To keep them in Orchester instead, import them as drafts and turn this off.
project_settings.importUnavailable: Repository import is not built in this app yet.
project_settings.baseMoved: Tell working agents when the base branch moves
project_settings.baseMovedDetail: When a merge, a commit or a pull moves the branch a run started from, the run's next agent that may write is told to merge it into its worktree, after its turn and never mid-edit. Moves within two minutes are one notice.
project_settings.baseMovedOn: On · writing agents merge the moved base early
project_settings.baseBranchDetail: The branch new runs start from and deliver into: Merge, the merge queue, Local integration, pull requests and base-moved notices follow it. With Checked-out branch, a run takes the branch your checkout has when it starts.
project_settings.baseBranchMissing: {{branch}} no longer exists in the repository, so new runs are refused. Choose another base branch.
project_settings.baseBranchHint: Kept on this computer only, in a shared project too. A run keeps the branch it started from; a set branch is merged into beside your checkout when the checkout has another branch.

baseBranchKept.one: 1 unfinished run keeps the base branch it started from.
baseBranchKept.other: {{count}} unfinished runs keep the base branch they started from.

project_settings.autoDetail: A separate reviewer model answers the requests the rules leave to you, approving only those that clearly serve the task; the rest still ask you, with its reason. Each run can turn it on or off in its Approvals.
project_settings.reviewerDetail: The agent connection, model and effort that review requests. Until you choose, the first Claude Code connection reviews with Haiku 4.5.
project_settings.projectRulesDetail: Requests you approved for every run of this project. Orchester answers them in each run while what they run is unchanged; a changed QA script asks again.
project_settings.projectRulesNone: None. A start_qa_app request offers Approve for every run of this project.
project_settings.defaultBudgetDetail: Prefilled in New task. Leave empty for no limit: new runs then use the tokens they need.
project_settings.dailyBudgetDetail: Tokens all runs in this project may use per day. Shown in the status bar; new work waits once it is used up.
project_settings.timeDetail: Prefilled in New task. Counts active agent time only; time paused or waiting for you (plan approval, questions, permission requests) doesn't count. Leave empty for no limit.
project_settings.slotsDetail: Each agent at work in any run of this project takes one slot; command steps use slots of their own. Runs beyond it wait in the queue with the reason. A change applies at once: lowering it stops no agent, and new work waits until fewer agents work.
project_settings.qaSlotsDetail: QA copies of the app that this project's runs may have open together, to check their work in the window. Each one is a full build of the app, so more of them load the computer more. A run that wants one while all are open waits until one closes.
project_settings.noRunLimit: No limit · new runs use the tokens they need
project_settings.noDailyLimit: No limit · new work has no daily budget
project_settings.noTimeLimit: No limit · runs take the time they need
project_settings.changesDetail: Runs already started keep their budget and time limit. Agents working at once applies at once. QA apps at once applies to the next QA app a run starts: lowering it closes no open app.
project_settings.environmentDetail: Added to the environment of every agent CLI and command tool this project's runs start, on top of the cleaned environment every program gets (PATH, HOME, TEMP and the like). A command tool's own variables win over these.
project_settings.plainText: Stored and shown in plain text, so never put secrets here. Keys and tokens belong in Secrets.
project_settings.environmentChanges: Changes apply to the next agent or command that starts
project_settings.environmentChangesDetail: An agent or command already running keeps the environment it started with.
project_settings.confirmEnvironment: Change the environment for new agents and commands?
project_settings.confirmAuto: Change auto mode or its reviewer?
project_settings.confirmAutoDetail: The reviewer answers requests in your place. Requests it cannot approve still ask you.
project_settings.indexDetail: Orchester indexes the repository's tracked files at the revision a run starts from: languages and line counts, symbols, file outlines, Markdown headings and a package map. Agents get a built-in skill that searches the index with ripgrep.
project_settings.indexSettingDetail: Agents that start after a change follow it. An agent already working keeps what it started with.
project_settings.noIndexesDetail: No index yet · built when the next run starts
project_settings.indexOffNote: They read and search the repository directly. No index is built while this is off; turn it on to try the index.
project_settings.indexListDetail: Built per revision when a run starts, shared read-only by the runs from that revision, and removed together with the worktrees that used it.
project_settings.ripgrepDetail: The index skill searches with rg. Orchester copies it into .orchester/tools so it also runs inside the Codex sandbox.
project_settings.rgMissingDetail: Agents search without the index until ripgrep is available.
project_settings.outdatedDetail: Built by an earlier version of Orchester. Rebuild to use it.
project_settings.indexOffTitle: Agents get no index and no index skill
project_settings.rgSourcePath: Found on PATH · agents get a copy in .orchester/tools
project_settings.rgSourceWinget: Installed with winget · agents get a copy in .orchester/tools
project_settings.rgSourceCodex: Bundled with Codex CLI · agents get a copy in .orchester/tools
project_settings.rgSourceClaude: Bundled with Claude Code · agents get a copy in .orchester/tools
project_settings.rgSlowerTitle: Agents search more slowly without ripgrep
project_settings.rgSlowerDetail: They fall back to other searches and won't use the code index until rg is available.
project_settings.installHint: Installs ripgrep for your account. It is copied into the project when an agent starts.
project_settings.installerMissing: {{installer}} wasn't found. Install it first, then check again.
project_settings.installerUnsupported: Installing ripgrep is not available on this platform.
project_settings.installEndsWithApp: The install continues while you leave this page. Closing Orchester stops it.
project_settings.installContinues: The install continues while you leave this page or close Orchester.
project_settings.installCancelled: The install was cancelled. You can try again.
project_settings.installTimedOut: The installer didn't finish within {{elapsed}} and was stopped.
project_settings.installNotFoundAfter: The installer finished, but ripgrep still wasn't found. Check again before retrying.
project_settings.indexDirect: Agents read and search the repository directly
project_settings.reviewerApiProvider: Auto mode’s reviewer runs on a CLI’s own sign-in. This connection runs on an API provider; choose another one.
